prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) is helpful, averaging +1.6% after noise correction across 5 tests with 2 wins, though 3 tests showed no clear effect.
Finish redesigns (finish, redesign) are helpful, averaging +2.4% after noise correction across 2 tests with 1 win, though 1 test showed no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for adoption changes (adoption, new_screen; adoption, new_flow; adoption, redesign) with only 1 test each, all showing no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for path choice redesigns (choose_path, redesign) with only 1 test, which showed no clear effect.
Predictions are often too high, overestimating actual noise-corrected impact in most tests.
Predictions can sometimes underestimate actual impact, as seen in round 6 (+1.5% predicted vs +3.0% noise-corrected) and round 7 (+2.2% predicted vs +4.5% noise-corrected).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: +2.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.6% after noise correction, 5 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 81.5%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 71.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Story scroll layout for home intro screen: Rebuild the final home intro screen with a story scroll layout that presents onboarding completion steps sequentially. (why: Finish step has high mean duration (5815s) and finish redesigns have shown an average positive impact of +2.4%.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop sound check screen before waiting: Add a new screen named new_sound_check before waiting to let users adjust and test pet audio alerts before generation. (why: Home waiting step has a long median time of 201s and support received multiple bug reports regarding desktop feature misbehavior.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Companion trait choice sub-flow on pick friend screen: Add an interactive trait selection choice cards component to the pick friend screen to customize pet temperament. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate at 60.9%; interactive personality selection increases user connection and engagement.)
3: [choose_path, hint] Path customization hint on choose path screen: Add a helpful hint text to the choose_path screen clarifying that path selection can be changed in settings later. (why: Choose_path conversion is 76.2% with a mean time of 514s, indicating initial user hesitation.)
4: [sign_in, layout] Account sync focus layout on sign in screen: Switch sign_in to a centered layout emphasizing account synchronization. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, highlighting the need for clear sync messaging.)
5: [adoption, wait_info] Generation time estimate on upload photos screen: Enable generation time estimate and readiness notification fields on the photo upload screen. (why: Adoption duration takes median 89s / mean 1017s, and 3 emails reported custom pet generation failures.)
6: [home, wait_info] Mascot progress status on waiting screen: Add a pet mascot graphic and progress indicator component to the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting step exhibits long wait times (median 201s, mean 2336s); dynamic visual progress reassures waiting users.)
7: [finish, copy] Desktop control shortcut guide on home intro: Update copy on home_intro screen to clearly outline desktop shortcuts for hiding and controlling the pet. (why: Support received 3 emails from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after onboarding.)
8: [adoption, redesign] Stage layout redesign for photo upload screen: Redesign the upload_photos screen layout to stage view to focus user focus on pet photo selection. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate (60.9%) and support received 3 emails regarding custom pet generation errors.)
